brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is calling on President Trump to launch military strikes against Iran "as soon as possible," according to Israel's public broadcaster Kan, as reported by Middle East Eye.

The appeal reflects Israeli pressure on the incoming U.S. administration to take direct military action against Tehran, amid escalating regional tensions and concerns over Iran's nuclear program and military capabilities.
dek: Report: Netanyahu calls on Trump to launch attack on Iran 'as soon as possible' Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Trump to carry out strikes on Iran "as soon as possible", according to Israel’s public broadcaster Kan.
title: Netanyahu urges Trump to strike Iran immediately
